caption: The drawing depicts a wooden rocking chair placed on a plain, light beige background. The chair has a high back with three horizontal slats, the middle two of which are wavy in shape, and the top ends of the back posts are finished with small rounded knobs. The seat of the chair appears to be woven with a light yellowish material, likely straw or rush. The frame of the chair is made from light brown wood, with cylindrical legs and rounded spindles providing structural support. The rockers at the base are darker brown and curved, attached to the legs at both ends, enabling the rocking motion. There is a handwritten signature reading "Ed Bashaw" at the lower right of the drawing. The entire composition is centered within the image and rendered in a realistic style.
title: Rocking Chair
